prompt: Modern 3D animated character, Pixar style, a strong Kenyan warrior woman character, stylized proportions, vibrant colors, cinematic 3D render, include a title

plan.rationale: The design will focus on a strong, vibrant, and modern representation of a Kenyan warrior woman, staying true to the restrained, modern defaults mentioned. The character will be styled with Pixar's iconic proportions, ensuring a balanced and engaging visual. Vibrant colors will be used to capture the essence of the warrior's spirit and the Kenyan culture. The title will be bold and clear, fitting well within the modern aesthetic.

elements.content: A strong, modern 3D animated character of a Kenyan warrior woman, standing confidently with a shield and spear, wearing traditional attire with vibrant colors and intricate patterns.
A background landscape of a Kenyan savannah at sunset, with golden hues and wildlife, to set a majestic and inspiring scene.
A stylized title 'Kenyan Warrior Spirit' in bold, modern typography, positioned at the top center of the canvas, in the primary color #FF6F69.
